c1-kozlekedespolitika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Said It
c1-kozlekedespolitika-01.scenario: You have read about the state railway company MÁV in the years 2010–2024. A friend asks what the critics said about the tracks.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-01.prompt: Tell your friend what the critics said about track maintenance and what the government's reasoning added.
cues: Name the critics as the source and say what they said about maintenance
Name the government's reasoning as the other source and say what it added
c1-kozlekedespolitika-01.target: A bírálók szerint a pályák karbantartására kevés pénz jutott. A kormány indoklása szerint viszont az állam több fővonalat is felújított.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-01.english: According to the critics, little money went to track maintenance. According to the government's reasoning, however, the state also renovated several main lines.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-01.canDo: I can say who made a judgement about the railway and name the other side.

c1-kozlekedespolitika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Suspended Line
c1-kozlekedespolitika-02.scenario: You have read about the suspension of service on the branch lines in 2023. A friend asks why the service was suspended.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-02.prompt: Tell your friend what the government's reasoning said and what the local governments said.
cues: Give the government's reasoning: the ministry had no choice
Give the local governments' view: what the residents had to do
c1-kozlekedespolitika-02.target: A MÁV indoklása szerint a társaság kénytelen volt felfüggeszteni a forgalmat. Az önkormányzatok szerint a lakosok kénytelenek voltak buszra szállni.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-02.english: According to MÁV's reasoning, the company was forced to suspend the service. According to the local governments, the residents were forced to take a bus.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-02.canDo: I can say what a company or an authority was obliged to do or forced to do, in the past tense.

c1-kozlekedespolitika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long Contract
c1-kozlekedespolitika-03.scenario: You have read about the motorway concession of 2022. A friend asks why the critics objected to such a long contract.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-03.prompt: Tell your friend what the critics said about the length of the contract.
cues: Say whose view it is
Say how the length of the contract and the changing of the conditions go together
c1-kozlekedespolitika-03.target: A bírálók szerint minél hosszabb a koncesszió, annál nehezebb módosítani a feltételeket.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-03.english: According to the critics, the longer the concession, the harder it is to change the conditions.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-03.canDo: I can link the length of a contract to the freedom to change it with *minél … annál …*.

c1-kozlekedespolitika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Disputed Investment
c1-kozlekedespolitika-04.scenario: You have read about the Budapest–Belgrade railway. A friend asks how the project went on although its return was disputed.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-04.prompt: Tell your friend that the construction began although the return was disputed, and what the critics said.
cues: Say that the construction began although the return was disputed
Say what the critics said about the return
c1-kozlekedespolitika-04.target: Annak ellenére, hogy a megtérülés vitatott volt, az építés megkezdődött. A bírálók szerint a megtérülés bizonytalan.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-04.english: Although the return was disputed, construction began. According to the critics, the return is uncertain.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-04.canDo: I can say that something happened although there was an objection, with *annak ellenére, hogy …*.

c1-kozlekedespolitika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides on the Passes
c1-kozlekedespolitika-05.scenario: You have read about the cheap passes of 2023. A friend asks what the pro-government side and the experts said.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-05.prompt: Tell your friend what each side said about the passes.
cues: Say what the pro-government side said about the commuters
Say what the experts said about renovation
c1-kozlekedespolitika-05.target: A kormánypárti oldal azt mondta, hogy az olcsó bérlet segített az ingázóknak. A szakértők azt mondták, hogy a felújításra is szükség van.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-05.english: The pro-government side said that the cheap pass helped commuters. The experts said that renovation was also needed.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-05.canDo: I can report what the pro-government side and the experts said about the passes with *azt mondta, hogy …*.

c1-kozlekedespolitika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Unit
c1-kozlekedespolitika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a talk about transport policy from 2010 to 2026, a friend asks what you remember.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what the critics said about the motorway concession and how the period ended.
cues: Say what the critics said about the concession
Say what happened on 12 April 2026
c1-kozlekedespolitika-consolidation.target: A bírálók szerint minél hosszabb a koncesszió, annál nehezebb módosítani a feltételeket. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-consolidation.english: According to the critics, the longer the concession, the harder it is to change the conditions. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-kozlekedespolitika-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up the disputes about transport policy between 2010 and 2026, with the source of each view.

c1-kulturalisorokseg-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views of the Changes
c1-kulturalisorokseg-01.scenario: You have read about the changes in cultural institutions after 2010. A friend asks what the two sides said.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-01.prompt: Tell your friend what the pro-government side said and what the critics said.
cues: Give the pro-government side's view about the earlier decades
Give the critics' view about the new heads
c1-kulturalisorokseg-01.target: A kormánypárti oldal szerint korábban az egyik irányzat volt túlsúlyban. A bírálók szerint viszont az új vezetőket politikai lojalitás alapján választották ki.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-01.english: According to the pro-government side, one trend had been dominant earlier. According to the critics, however, the new heads were chosen on the basis of political loyalty.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-01.canDo: I can say who made a judgement about cultural policy and name the other side.

c1-kulturalisorokseg-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Should Have Decided
c1-kulturalisorokseg-02.scenario: You have read about the Petőfi Cultural Agency. A friend asks what the critics said about the decisions on funding.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-02.prompt: Tell your friend who should have decided about the funding, according to the critics.
cues: Name the critics as the source
Say who should have decided about the funding
c1-kulturalisorokseg-02.target: A bírálók szerint a szakmai testületeknek kellett volna dönteniük a támogatásokról.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-02.english: According to the critics, professional bodies should have decided about the funding.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-02.canDo: I can say what should have happened, according to a named source, with *kellett volna*.

c1-kulturalisorokseg-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Funding and Running Costs
c1-kulturalisorokseg-03.scenario: You have read about the funding of independent theatre companies. A friend asks what the companies said.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-03.prompt: Tell your friend what the independent companies said about funding and operation.
cues: Name the independent companies as the source
Say how the size of the funding and the difficulty of operation go together
c1-kulturalisorokseg-03.target: A független társulatok szerint minél kisebb a támogatás, annál nehezebb a működés.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-03.english: According to the independent companies, the smaller the funding, the harder the operation.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-03.canDo: I can link the size of funding to the difficulty of operation with *minél … annál …*.

c1-kulturalisorokseg-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views of the Academy
c1-kulturalisorokseg-04.scenario: You have read about the Hungarian Academy of Arts. A friend asks what its members and its critics said.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-04.prompt: Tell your friend what the members said and what the critics said.
cues: Give the members' view about the representation of artists
Give the critics' view about the academy's influence
c1-kulturalisorokseg-04.target: Az MMA tagjai szerint a testület a művészek képviseletét szolgálta. A bírálók szerint viszont túl nagy befolyáshoz jutott.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-04.english: According to the members of the MMA, the body served the representation of artists. According to the critics, however, it gained too much influence.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-04.canDo: I can set two views of one institution against each other, naming the source of each.

c1-kulturalisorokseg-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Camps
c1-kulturalisorokseg-05.scenario: You have read about the debate on cultural life before the 2026 election. A friend asks what the critics and the pro-government side said.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-05.prompt: Tell your friend what each side said about cultural life.
cues: Say what the critics said about the two camps
Say what the pro-government side said about diversity
c1-kulturalisorokseg-05.target: A bírálók azt mondták, hogy a kulturális élet két táborra szakadt. A kormánypárti oldal azt mondta, hogy a kulturális élet sokszínű.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-05.english: The critics said that cultural life had split into two camps. The pro-government side said that cultural life was diverse.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-05.canDo: I can report what the critics and the pro-government side said about cultural life with *azt mondta, hogy …*.

c1-kulturalisorokseg-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Unit
c1-kulturalisorokseg-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a talk about cultural policy from 2010 to 2026, a friend asks what you remember.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what the critics said about the Hungarian Academy of Arts and how the period ended.
cues: Say what the members and the critics said about the academy
Say what happened on 12 April 2026
c1-kulturalisorokseg-consolidation.target: Az MMA tagjai szerint a testület a művészek képviseletét szolgálta. A bírálók szerint viszont túl nagy befolyáshoz jutott. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-consolidation.english: According to the members of the MMA, the body served the representation of artists. According to the critics, however, it gained too much influence. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-kulturalisorokseg-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up the disputes about cultural policy between 2010 and 2026, with the source of each view.

c1-geopolitika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views of a Policy
c1-geopolitika-01.scenario: You have read about the Opening to the East. A friend asks what the government's reasoning and the critics said.
c1-geopolitika-01.prompt: Tell your friend what the government's reasoning said and what the critics said.
cues: Give the government's reasoning about new export markets
Give the critics' view about the western relations
c1-geopolitika-01.target: A kormány indoklása szerint új exportpiacokra is szükség volt. A bírálók szerint viszont a politika terhelte a nyugati kapcsolatokat.
c1-geopolitika-01.english: According to the government's reasoning, new export markets were also needed. According to the critics, however, the policy strained the western relations.
c1-geopolitika-01.canDo: I can say who made a judgement about foreign policy and name the other side.

c1-geopolitika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Notification Rule
c1-geopolitika-02.scenario: You have read about the Paks II project. A friend asks what the EU rules required.
c1-geopolitika-02.prompt: Tell your friend what the member states had to do with state aid.
cues: Name the EU rules as the source
Say what the member state was obliged to do
c1-geopolitika-02.target: Az uniós szabályok szerint a tagállam köteles bejelenteni az állami támogatást az Európai Bizottságnak.
c1-geopolitika-02.english: According to the EU rules, a member state is obliged to notify state aid to the European Commission.
c1-geopolitika-02.canDo: I can say what a state or a company was obliged to do, with *köteles*.

c1-geopolitika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Many Parties, One Decision
c1-geopolitika-03.scenario: You have read about the veto disputes in the EU. A friend asks why unanimous decisions were hard.
c1-geopolitika-03.prompt: Tell your friend how the number of member states and the difficulty of the decision go together.
cues: Say how many member states have to agree
Say how hard the decision is
c1-geopolitika-03.target: Minél több tagállamnak kell egyetértenie, annál nehezebb az egyhangú döntés.
c1-geopolitika-03.english: The more member states have to agree, the harder a unanimous decision is.
c1-geopolitika-03.canDo: I can link the number of parties to the difficulty of a decision with *minél … annál …*.

c1-geopolitika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Plant and Its Critics
c1-geopolitika-04.scenario: You have read about the battery plant in Debrecen. A friend asks how the work went on while there were concerns.
c1-geopolitika-04.prompt: Tell your friend that construction went on although concerns were raised, and what the government's reasoning said.
cues: Say that construction went on although concerns were raised
Say what the government's reasoning said about jobs
c1-geopolitika-04.target: Annak ellenére, hogy aggályok merültek fel, az építkezés tovább haladt. A kormány indoklása szerint a beruházások új munkahelyeket teremtenek.
c1-geopolitika-04.english: Although concerns were raised, construction went on. According to the government's reasoning, the investments create new jobs.
c1-geopolitika-04.canDo: I can say that construction went on although concerns were raised, with *annak ellenére, hogy …*.

c1-geopolitika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Peace or Funds
c1-geopolitika-05.scenario: You have read about the foreign policy debate before the 2026 election. A friend asks what the two sides said.
c1-geopolitika-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the pro-government side said and what the opposition said.
cues: Say what the pro-government side said about peace and sovereignty
Say what the opposition said about the EU funds
c1-geopolitika-05.target: A kormánypárti oldal azt mondta, hogy a kormány a békét és a szuverenitást védi. Az ellenzék azt mondta, hogy az uniós források megszerzése fontos cél.
c1-geopolitika-05.english: The pro-government side said that the government defended peace and sovereignty. The opposition said that obtaining the EU funds was an important aim.
c1-geopolitika-05.canDo: I can report what the pro-government side and the opposition said with *azt mondta, hogy …*.

c1-geopolitika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Unit
c1-geopolitika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a talk about foreign policy from 2010 to 2026, a friend asks what you remember.
c1-geopolitika-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what the government's reasoning said about the gas contract and how the period ended.
cues: Say what the government's reasoning said about the contract
Say what happened on 12 April 2026
c1-geopolitika-consolidation.target: A kormány indoklása szerint a szerződés az ellátásbiztonságot szolgálta. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-geopolitika-consolidation.english: According to the government's reasoning, the contract served security of supply. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-geopolitika-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up the disputes about foreign policy between 2010 and 2026, with the source of each view.
